findings.claim_summary: Adapter signal: TypeORM migration surfaces show repeated boilerplate across services — at least three migrations follow the same add-column-then-index pattern with no shared helper

Plan 016 implementation arc shipped nine SHADOW adapter rows + four impact graph source stubs without operator-facing parser implementations and zero PR pipeline test coverage; the Plan 016 sign-off review recorded each of the three architectural debts but the DEBT records emitted in Plan 017 Phase 2 cite F-001 (TypeORM duplication) as their originating finding, which has no content link to any of the three debts.
